invariants.rationale: A new TextureRegion is always constructed and returned, so result is never null.
The TextureRegion is constructed from images.get(name), which must be non-null to construct a valid TextureRegion.
If the provided name is not null, images.get(name) is passed to TextureRegion; likely the contract expects a non-null value.
The method always returns a TextureRegion object.
